recording_id.description: Unique identifier for each recording; joins to phenotype/task/recording.tsv.

task_name.description: The audio task conducted for the recording.

task_family.description: The task label without its trailing item numbers (e.g. harvard-sentences-list)

branch.description: the branch that owns the family (SPEECH, VOICE or AIRWAY), else none

levels.none: no branch owns the declared family

task_start_s.description: start of the task extent in the recording, seconds

task_end_s.description: end of the task extent in the recording, seconds

task_events_found.description: breaths, coughs or syllables/cycles the task layer found; empty for other families

task_events_instructed.description: the count the instruction asked for; empty where the family is not counted

level_rel_session_db.description: the recording's level against its session, dB

active_s.description: seconds of activity in the plain stream

snr_db.description: the plain stream's active frame level (95th percentile) over its noise floor, whole file, dB (recording_vectors q_plain_snr_db)

noise_floor_dbfs.description: the plain stream's 10th-percentile frame level, whole file, dBFS (recording_vectors q_plain_floor_dbfs)

session_background_dbfs.description: the session's background level from the residual of its speech tasks, dBFS (SESSION's session_floor)

speech_over_residual_db.description: the enhanced foreground over the residual, whole file, dB (speech_residual foreground_minus_residual_db); empty where the enhanced stream carries no speech

squim_pesq.description: the median SQUIM PESQ over the plain stream's spans; empty for airway families

squim_stoi.description: the median SQUIM STOI over the plain stream's spans; empty for airway families

squim_si_sdr.description: the median SQUIM SI-SDR over the plain stream's spans, dB; empty for airway families

clipped_s.description: seconds the clip detector's live spans hold (PREPROCESS clip spans); empty where PREPROCESS did not measure the recording

dropout_s.description: seconds of dropout in the raw recording (disruptions_file)

lexical_words_n.description: lexical consensus words; empty where SPEECH did not read the recording

asr_agreement.description: the share of consensus words both recognisers agree on

asr_degenerate_n.description: recogniser loop or garbage tokens dropped from the consensus

masked_s.description: seconds of the task extent the redaction masks; empty when withheld or discarded

masked_fraction.description: masked_s over task_duration_s; empty when withheld or discarded

speaker_target_cosine.description: the task's own speech, pooled, against the participant's enrollment (COHORT); empty where not compared

speaker_non_task_cosine.description: the speech outside the task, pooled, against the participant's enrollment (COHORT); empty where not compared

session_consistency_cosine.description: the session's enrollment against the participant's other sessions' (COHORT)

enrollment_source.description: what the cosines compare against, session, participant_other_sessions or none

levels.session: the participant's speech in the same session
levels.participant_other_sessions: the participant's speech in their other sessions
levels.none: no enrollment could be built; the cosines are empty

pipeline_commit.description: the senselab commit the decision was last written under

schema_version.description: this table's version, the version key of triage_table.yaml
